records.name: pregenesis-grammar
records.summary: The Pre-Genesis host grammar declares the inscription alphabet {<, >, a, b} and three public starts: ground_token (exactly <>), inscription (one balanced, non-nested bracketed inscription) and pre_genesis_regime (zero or more inscriptions between braces, where {} is host list notation and not the empty word). records.name: replay-necessity
records.summary: Let H be the possible histories, σ(h) the state that history h produces and π(h) the part of h an auditor sees, for example only the last turn. If π(h₁) = π(h₂) but σ(h₁) ≠ σ(h₂), no auditor A that sees only π reports σ(h) for every h, because A(π(h₁)) = A(π(h₂)) would give σ(h₁) = σ(h₂). The trial failures motivate the theorem: the blind auditor flagged the licensed words 'We' (Trial 1) and 'rule' (Trial 2) as imports, so an audit needs two levels; in Trial 2, Prompt 14's false attribution was answered without objection, so claim provenance is a check separate from claim correctness, Result 15 lost the state, saying the regime contains only <> after <a> had been supplied; and the two-level auditor, shown only that turn, answered None. State certification therefore needs replay information that separates the relevant histories, and on a declared finite population a summary on which σ is constant per fiber of the view can stand in for the raw history.
records.obligation: Reject any auditor that certifies the adopted state from a view π under which two admissible histories with different states coincide, and give it the replayed history or a summary on which σ is constant per fiber.
records.fence: The trial contrasts motivate the theorem and do not instantiate it: the truncated window and the full replay received different inputs, so they are not a checked pair with equal auditor views; raw history retention is a provenance policy, and task-sufficient reconstruction is the mathematical requirement.

records.name: contexts-plugging-profiles
records.summary: A context is an admitted form with a slot tuple of its arity in which every filled slot names an admitted datum and at least one slot is a hole; plugging a datum fills every hole with that same datum. Derivability is membership in the admitted instances or coverage by a uniform all-tuples rule, and no other inference exists. The profile of a datum is the set of well-formed contexts whose plugging is derivable. records.name: context-count-formula
records.summary: For a regime with n admitted data, a form of arity a has (n+1)^a − n^a well-formed contexts: each slot is a hole or one of n data, less the n^a hole-free tuples, so |Ctx(R)| = Σ_f ((n+1)^{a_f} − n^{a_f}), with distinct form identifiers kept disjoint even when their arities coincide. records.summary: If a representative map C lies in each regime's isomorphism orbit and is constant on orbits, then C(R) = C(S) exactly when R ≅ S, and an injective serialization of the representatives gives the same criterion for keys (key_classification, conditional on both hypotheses). Companion results remove those hypotheses for the concrete search: equal sorted five-field tuples after relabeling by supplied bijections imply isomorphism (serializedRelabel_sound), and the length-prefixed unsigned 64-bit wire encoding is injective on words below 2^64 (portableBytes_injective). Exhaustive search over all datum and form permutations attains a least structural key (canonicalKey_attained), and for well-formed regimes with duplicate-free collections the keys, and under the word bounds their byte encodings, are equal exactly when the regimes are isomorphic (canonicalKey_classification, canonicalBytes_classification).
records.obligation: Show that the exhaustive-search canonical key and its portable byte encoding are equal exactly when two well-formed, duplicate-free regimes are isomorphic, within the unsigned-word bounds.
records.fence: The abstract key_classification needs an in-orbit, orbit-invariant choice; the concrete search results assume no orbit oracle but cover the Lean search only, and refinement of the optimized Python and Rust programs remains a separate engineering obligation, checked by finite agreement on 1,436 labelled regimes.

records.name: incidence-construction-betti
records.summary: Starting from the literal supply of <>, the WDP construction records Supply(<>) without admitting it, then supplies and admits <a>, <ab> and <c>, forms of arities 1, 2 and 3, three unary vertex instances and the edges 01, 12 and 02. Under an explicitly chosen incidence interpretation (a datum's admission index is a vertex, an arity-k form carries (k−1)-dimensional simplices, an instance lists its increasing vertex indices, and every vertex and face needs its own instance) the cycle has rational Betti numbers (1, 1), and admitting the single instance 012 gives (1, 0, 0). The education Lean module establishes these Betti numbers from explicit integer kernels and images of the boundary matrices (cycle_rational_betti, filled_rational_betti) and that its incidence reading returns the cycle and filled simplex lists (cycle_incidence_eq, filled_incidence_eq). For a general face-closed family K, that the construction's interpretation is exactly K rests on a written argument.
records.obligation: Replay the literal-root walk, read admitted instances as simplices under the declared interpretation, and compute rational Betti numbers (1, 1) for the cycle and (1, 0, 0) after the filling.
imports: Declared incidence interpretation of admitted forms and instances as simplices, incidence_construction.txt (assumption)
records.fence: The interpretation is a construction choice, not extracted from the spelling of <>; the general construction result is a written argument, the Lean covers the worked three-vertex complex only, and no Lean refinement of the Rust implementation is claimed.

python.absent: no Python implementation of the incidence reading or its homology

records.name: genesis-three-axis-verdict
records.summary: The final source closeout records three independent axes after the author's 2026-09-28 freeze of snapshot 90ab34a0: research_phase CLOSED_WITH_OPEN_OBSTRUCTIONS, alpha_reference READY_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE and original_seed_completion_gate UNSATISFIED, the last with its live-injection and comparison clauses unmet and the input-count floor NOT_ESTABLISHED. A source defect stays on the record: delta_events names a fresh datum w<n> from the current datum count, so when the sole admitted token is w1 a NewDatum item emits AdmitDatum(w1) and deduplication leaves the state unchanged; the standalone replay reproduces this. Pinned Lean modules use only propext and Quot.sound, companion results such as the carrier-general image factorization also use Classical.choice, and the compiled census reports 2,475 non-internal theorem constants. Native Rust and frozen Python agree on every context observation and portable key over 1,436 regimes, and the compiled Lean wire encoder agrees with Python on 1,439 tuples.
records.obligation: Keep the three axes as separate verdicts, reproduce the w1 fresh-label collision, and report the axiom census and the finite cross-language agreement populations with their scopes.
records.fence: The axis values are recorded author-approved verdicts, not computed results: a closed stage does not imply readiness, companion work does not rewrite the frozen gate, and finite agreement is not a compiler-verified refinement proof for all source code.
